license_required.quote: No person shall begin the practice of dentistry, or dental hygiene, without first obtaining a license for such purpose from the office of professional licensure and certification.

issuing_authority.value: Office of Professional Licensure and Certification
issuing_authority.quote: without first obtaining a license for such purpose from the office of professional licensure and certification

name.value: Office of Professional Licensure and Certification
name.quote: without first obtaining a license for such purpose from the office of professional licensure and certification

type.quote: Applications for licensure to practice dentistry shall be made to the office of professional licensure and certification

age_minimum.quote: The applicant shall be of good professional character and 18 years of age or older.

moral_character_required.quote: The applicant shall be of good professional character and 18 years of age or older.

degree_required.quote: satisfactory proof that the applicant is a graduate of a school that is recognized by the Commission on Dental Accreditation (CODA) and holds the degree of D.D.S. or D.M.D.

accrediting_body.quote: a graduate of a school that is recognized by the Commission on Dental Accreditation (CODA)

exams.name: Dental licensure examination (national, regional, or board-administered)
exams.notes: May be oral, clinical, written, or any combination; or a national/regional test approved by the board
exams.quote: Applicants for a license to practice dentistry or dental hygiene shall pass an examination as determined by the board or have successfully passed a national or regional test approved by the board.

interval_years.quote: shall notify the office of professional licensure and certification in writing within 30 days of any change of business or residential address which may occur during the period between biennial registrations

required.quote: Continuing education requirements for licensees and holders of certificates

regulatory_model.quote: any person practicing or offering to practice dentistry in New Hampshire must submit evidence that such person is qualified to so practice and shall be licensed as provided in this chapter

credential_type.quote: No person shall begin the practice of dentistry, or dental hygiene, without first obtaining a license for such purpose from the office of professional licensure and certification.

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice dentistry in New Hampshire or use any title, sign, card, device or the abbreviation D.M.D. or D.D.S., or any other designation indicating that such person is practicing dentistry unless such person has been licensed under the provisions of this chapter.

title_protection.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice dentistry in New Hampshire or use any title, sign, card, device or the abbreviation D.M.D. or D.D.S., or any other designation indicating that such person is practicing dentistry unless such person has been licensed under the provisions of this chapter.

scope_protection.quote: No person shall begin the practice of dentistry, or dental hygiene, without first obtaining a license for such purpose from the office of professional licensure and certification.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Addiction to mind-altering drugs or intoxicants
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Addiction to mind-altering drugs or intoxicants.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of any felony or misdemeanor involving dishonesty, untrustworthiness, or unprofessional conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commission of any felony or misdemeanor involving dishonesty, untrustworthiness, or unprofessional conduct

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or untruthfulness in obtaining educational credentials, examination scores, or professional licensure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The practice of fraud or untruthfulness in obtaining educational credentials, examination scores, or professional licensure in this or any other jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Affliction with a physical or mental impairment or disease dangerous to public health or precluding practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Affliction with a physical or mental impairment or disease which is dangerous to the public health or which precludes the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene at ordinary levels of proficiency.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Ignorance, incompetence, or a pattern of behavior inconsistent with basic knowledge and skills expected of licensees
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Ignorance, incompetence, or a pattern of behavior inconsistent with the basic knowledge and skills expected of persons licensed to practice dentistry or dental hygiene.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross or repeated negligence in practicing dentistry or dental hygiene
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross or repeated negligence in practicing dentistry or dental hygiene.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentionally injuring a patient or engaging in unprofessional or dishonest conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Intentionally injuring a patient or engaging in any other unprofessional or dishonest conduct in practicing dentistry or dental hygiene.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to follow current ADA or CDC guidelines as adopted by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to follow the current guidelines of: (1) The American Dental Association, as adopted, in whole or in part, by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising dental practice using deceptive or misleading messages
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising the licensee's dental practice by using any newspaper, broadcast, cable transmission, telephone, sign, poster, or other advertising message which: (1) Deceives or is intended to deceive the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing or permitting an unlicensed person to practice in the licensee's office
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing or permitting an unlicensed person to practice in the licensee's office.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly or willfully violating any provision of this chapter, board rules, or applicable laws
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly or willfully violating any provision of this chapter, any substantive rule or order of the dental board, any federal, state, or local controlled drug law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having more than one patient under moderate/deep sedation or general anesthesia without one-to-one continuous monitoring
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having more than one patient undergoing moderate sedation, deep sedation, or general anesthesia on an outpatient basis at any given time unless each patient is being continuously monitored on a one-to-one ratio

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to have patients recovering from sedation/anesthesia closely monitored by licensed health professionals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to have patients recovering from moderate sedation, deep sedation, or general anesthesia closely monitored by licensed health professionals experienced in the care and resuscitation of patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to continuously monitor patients with a pulse oximeter or equivalent during or after sedation/anesthesia
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to have patients continuously monitored with a pulse oximeter or similar or superior monitoring equipment required by the board while undergoing or recovering from moderate sedation, deep sedation, or general anesthesia.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to perform adequate history and physical or obtain written informed consent prior to administering anesthesia/sedation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to perform an adequate history and physical as defined in rules under RSA 317-A:12, XII-a(h) or to obtain the written informed consent of a patient prior to the administering general anesthesia, deep sedation, or moderate sedation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report an adverse event or implement a corrective action plan as required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report an adverse event or implement a corrective action plan as required by RSA 317-A:20-a.

definition_quote.value: A person shall be regarded as practicing dentistry within the meaning of this chapter who: (a) Uses or permits to be used, directly or indirectly, for profit or otherwise, for that person or for any other person, in connection with the person's name, the word "dentist", or "dental surgeon", or the title "D.D.S." or "D.M.D.", or any other words, letters, titles, or descriptive matter, personal or not, which directly or indirectly imply the practice of dentistry; ... (d) Undertakes, by any means or method, including by use of electronic media, gratuitously or for a salary, fee, money, or other reward paid or granted directly or indirectly to that person or to any other person, to diagnose or profess to diagnose, to treat or profess to treat, or prescribe for or profess to prescribe for any of the lesions, diseases, disorders, or deficiencies of the human oral cavity, teeth, gums, maxilla, or mandible or adjacent associated structures
definition_quote.quote: A person shall be regarded as practicing dentistry within the meaning of this chapter who

value: diagnosis and treatment of lesions, diseases, disorders, or deficiencies of the oral cavity, teeth, gums, maxilla, mandible, and adjacent structures
administration of dental anesthetics (general or local)
furnishing, constructing, reproducing, or repairing prosthetic dentures, bridges, appliances, or other structures
dispensing teeth whitening agents or whitening/bleaching teeth
use of electronic media for dental services
methods_authorized.quote: Undertakes, by any means or method, including by use of electronic media, gratuitously or for a salary, fee, money, or other reward paid or granted directly or indirectly to that person or to any other person, to diagnose or profess to diagnose, to treat or profess to treat, or prescribe for or profess to prescribe for any of the lesions, diseases, disorders, or deficiencies of the human oral cavity, teeth, gums, maxilla, or mandible or adjacent associated structures

drug_authority.value: Dentists may prescribe controlled drugs pursuant to RSA 318-B:41 and administer dental anesthetics, either general or local
drug_authority.quote: Administers dental anesthetics, either general or local

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: Any dentist or dental facility who wishes to administer general anesthesia, deep sedation, or moderate sedation shall apply to the office of professional licensure and certification for the appropriate permit

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: On-site evaluations of personnel, facility, equipment, and records as they pertain to the use of required drugs, general anesthesia, deep sedation, or moderate sedation, or any combination thereof.

sedation_adverse_event_reporting_require.quote: Any dentist licensed pursuant to this chapter shall report to the board the occurrence of any adverse health care events resulting in death, brain damage, or hospitalization, occurring in the dentist's office or facility while utilizing general anesthesia, deep sedation, or moderate sedation, as soon as is reasonably and practically possible, but no later than 15 working days after discovery of the event.

pediatric_sedation_endorsement_required.quote: Administration of general anesthesia or deep sedation to patients under the age of 13 shall be subject to additional rules

specialist_license_available.quote: All advertisements of dental services shall contain the name of the dentist whose services are being advertised and shall state whether each dentist is a general dentist or, if qualified, a specialist in the named area or specialization.

specialty_advertising_disclaimer_require.quote: The dentist's name and designation as a general dentist or specialist shall be stated prominently in the advertisement.

value: public health supervision of an actively licensed dentist
dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: Dental hygiene services shall be provided under the supervision of a licensed dentist in accordance with rules adopted by the board.

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: Under the public health supervision of an actively licensed dentist and in accordance with a written practice agreement, a certified public health dental hygienist may provide services

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: A dental hygienist licensed under this chapter may obtain a certification to practice as a certified public health dental hygienist by submitting an application to the office of professional licensure and certification and completing additional educational and training requirements as required by the board.

value: patients in hospitals or other institutions
advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: A certified public health dental hygienist, acting under the public health supervision of an actively licensed dentist, may practice in a school, hospital, or other institution, or for a homebound person without the dentist having to be present

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: Dentists acting as a manager, proprietor, partnership, association, or corporation owning, managing, or controlling any place where dental work is done, provided, or contracted for shall employ, keep, or retain only licensed dentists to practice dentistry and licensed dental hygienists to practice dental hygiene.

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: Except on the written prescription of a duly licensed dentist and by the use of impressions or casts made by a duly licensed and practicing dentist, directly or indirectly by mail, carrier, personal agent, or by any other method, furnishes, supplies, constructs, reproduces, or repairs prosthetic dentures, bridges, appliances, or other structures

teledentistry_authorized.quote: Persons licensed by the board shall be permitted to provide services through the use of "telemedicine", as defined in RSA 310:7.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: The administration of local anesthesia, provided the dental hygienist is qualified by the board after training and after passing an examination approved by the board.

hygienist_nitrous_oxide_certification_re.quote: The administration of nitrous oxide/oxygen minimal sedation (anxiolysis); provided the dental hygienist is qualified by the board after training and after passing an examination approved by the board.

restorative_function_endorsement_availab.quote: A dental hygienist licensed under this chapter, or a dental assistant may obtain a permit from the office of professional licensure and certification to practice as an expanded function dental auxiliary

patient_record_retention_years.quote: A dentist shall maintain patients' paper or electronic, and radiographic records, for at least 7 years from the time the dentist or dental hygienist last treated the patient.

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: The dentist shall be trained in pediatric advanced life support (PALS) and airway management, equivalent to the American Academy of Pediatrics and American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry (AAP-AAPD) guidelines or equivalent as determined by the board.

dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_li.quote: A dental hygienist licensed under this chapter may obtain a certification to practice as a certified public health dental hygienist by submitting an application to the office of professional licensure and certification and completing additional educational and training requirements as required by the board.
